records.summary: Refreshed XRP derivatives positioning, issuer-reported ETF holdings/flows, Circle global USDC supply, Coinbase XRP-backed USDC loan terms, U.S. macro fund flows and Binance's aggregate incident response. Re-audited current main and open PRs. Added a scheduler allowlist hardening successor PR after finding that two workflows in PR #1389 were not yet safe for unattended dispatch. No market feature admitted and no forecast issued.
actions: Captured Liqwall's 00:52 UTC XRP derivatives panel with price, open interest, liquidations, funding and Binance account positioning.
Reconciled settled October 26–29 ETF holdings changes with fund-coverage caveats and preserved the provisional October 30 row as excluded.
Cross-checked Alpha Finance's five-fund October 29 flow and recorded its material price-basis discrepancy against XRP Insights.
Verified Circle's $70B global USDC circulation display as of October 29 and 38 native networks including Base and XRPL.
Rechecked Coinbase's official XRP collateral loan page and Help terms: Morpho on Base, up to $100,000 USDC against XRP, XRP eligibility and prohibition on Coinbase-trading use of loan proceeds.
Captured Reuters' October 30 U.S. fund-flow context and Binance aggregate reserve/freeze response without assigning either to XRP-specific capital flows.
Audited current main SHA, 165 open PRs, stale base distribution, scheduler allowlist proposals, exact-head CI and fail-closed gates.
Created PR #1390 as a fresh-main successor to PR #1389, removing formal-verification and SINDy workflows from the unattended allowlist pending separate hardening/review.
blockers: Derivatives open-interest and funding coverage is not synchronized across providers.
ETF holdings/flow aggregators have different fund universes, provisional rows and price bases.
Circle's global USDC supply is not a chain-level Base/XRPL supply or Morpho supplier measure.
Coinbase's XRP loan origination and Morpho channel share are undisclosed; loan proceeds cannot be used on Coinbase and off-platform flows are untraced.
Binance's aggregate reserve statement does not resolve XRP-specific reserve replenishment or XRPL PoR wallet membership.
Full repository CI and dependency vulnerability scanning remain unrun.
next_actions: Obtain issuer-native ETF holdings files and reconcile each fund by ticker, shares, XRP per share, net assets and settled timestamp; do not include provisional rows.
Build synchronized exchange-native XRP futures OI/funding/liquidation series with contract identifiers and common UTC cutoffs.
Reconcile Coinbase/Morpho cbXRP market data from block-consistent onchain reads; distinguish Coinbase interface traffic from permissionless market activity.
Trace representative Morpho liquidation paths through cbXRP transfer, unwrap/redemption and any eventual native XRP sale; do not assume transmission.
Resolve Binance's official October 1 XRPL address membership and November 1 PoR asset-level balances.
Run fixed-horizon walk-forward baselines and calibration only after point-in-time feature history and leakage controls are implemented.
Run fresh-main merge-result validation for PR #1388 and keep PR #1390 draft/unmerged pending independent review.
